title: 🙏📖 "Finding Our Way to the Father: A Blessed Bible Study Session" 🌿
paragraphs: 🙏📖 "Finding Our Way to the Father: A Blessed Bible Study Session" 🌿
What an amazing evening spent delving into the profound topic of "Jesus is the only way to the Father" with the wonderful staff of Weegols Garden! 🌱✨
I am truly grateful to my cousin Jeremiah Betia Calo for opening up his beautiful establishment and his incredible team to host this enlightening ministry. Their support means the world to me! 🙌
And a special shoutout to my bro Mayor Dr. Edward U. Chan, whose unwavering understanding and support have allowed me to continue on my Kingdom assignment. Your kindness is deeply appreciated. 🤗💕
May our journey of faith continue to be filled with blessings, love, and understanding. 🙏✨ #BibleStudy #FaithJourney #Gratitude #BlessedMinistry
